scenario.zh: 如果你突然中了500万，你最有可能会做哪些事情？
scenario.en: Out of nowhere, you win a few million in the lottery. Which of these would you most likely do?

text.zh: 把消息藏好，暂时谁也不说
text.en: Keep it quiet — tell no one for now

interpretation.zh: 你可能把安全感放在第一位，重要的事先守住再说。
interpretation.en: Security may come first for you: protect what matters before anything else.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于先守住重要信息，暂缓公开。

text.zh: 终于可以不用为了赚钱，去做自己不喜欢的事情
text.en: Finally stop doing work I don’t like just to pay the bills

interpretation.zh: 你似乎很清楚：钱最大的用处，是把选择权还给自己。
interpretation.en: You seem clear that money’s real use is buying back your own choices.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把财富理解为摆脱经济约束、拿回选择权。

text.zh: 把钱存好，基本继续原来的生活
text.en: Put it away and mostly keep living as before

interpretation.zh: 你可能更珍惜已经运转良好的日常。
interpretation.en: You may treasure a daily life that already works.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于让财富进入储备，而不改变生活结构。

text.zh: 让家人的生活过得更好
text.en: Make life better for my family

interpretation.zh: 好日子在你这里，第一个念头是带上家人。
interpretation.en: When good things arrive, your first thought is to bring your family along.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把好事第一时间导向家人的生活。

text.zh: 好好享受生活，不给自己留下遗憾

interpretation.zh: 你可能相信，生活的意义要趁现在去感受——别给自己留遗憾。
interpretation.en: You may believe life is meant to be felt now — don’t leave regrets behind.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把好运兑换成不留遗憾的体验本身。

text.zh: 重新规划人生，做好投资，为未来做好长期准备
text.en: Replan my life — invest well and set up for the long term

interpretation.zh: 你似乎习惯把好运变成一张长期的路线图。
interpretation.en: You seem to turn good luck into a long-term roadmap.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把突来的资源纳入长期的准备与规划。

text.zh: 拿出一部分帮助真正有需要的人
text.en: Give part of it to people who truly need it

interpretation.zh: 你的幸福感，似乎和更大的世界连在一起。
interpretation.en: Your sense of happiness seems connected to a bigger world.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把好运的一部分导向更大的共同体。
